Name: Butter and Nut Pound Cake
Ingredients: ['3 cups sugar', '12 cup Crisco', '1 cup butter', '5 eggs', '23 cup evaporated milk', '13 cup water', '14 teaspoon salt', '3 14 cups flour', '2 tablespoons butter flavoring', '1 tablespoon vanilla-nut flavoring', '1 cup pecans (optional)']
Instructions: ['Cream the sugar and crisco.', 'Add remaining ingredients and mix well.', 'Pour into a greased and floured bundt pan.', 'Place in a COLD oven.', 'Turn oven to 325 and bake 1 hour and 30 minutes.']

Name: Macaroni Salad
Ingredients: ['32 ounces uncooked macaroni noodles', '1 cup mayonnaise', '14 cup vinegar', '23 cup sugar', '2 12 tablespoons mustard', '1 12 teaspoons salt', '1 large onion, chopped', '2 stalks celery, chopped', '4 eggs, diced (optional)', 'pepper']
Instructions: ['First heat the water up to a rolling boil, then add the noodles.', 'Cook for ten minute, then drain.', 'At the same time boil the eggs for at least 10 to 15 minutes.Next mix the mayo, mustard, vinegar, sugar, and salt together.', 'Mix this in with the noodles, and then add the onion, celery, and eggs.', 'Put in the fridge for at least an hour to get cold.', 'Then serve.']

Name: Couscous
Ingredients: ['1 12 cups couscous, medium sized', '1 grapefruit', '2 tablespoons sunflower oil', '18 cup mint leaf', '12 cup parsley, curley chopped (2/3 works)', '2 roma tomatoes', '1 14 cups water', '2 garlic cloves', '12 teaspoon salt']
Instructions: ['Squeeze the juice of the grapefruit and place in large measuring cup.', 'boil the water and add to grapefruit with mint and oil and garlic.', 'Place cous cous in large enough wide pot with a cover.', 'once the mint has steaped for a minute or two (remove mint and chop) place the water/grapefruit/oil/mint/garlic mixture in pot with couscous.', 'with a fork fluff quickly mixing completely and cover for a 2 minutes and fluff again/cover 1 minute.', 'add parsley and salt fluff and cover for 1 minute.', 'taste to see if cous cous has softned but still firm.', 'Chop tomato and place in mixtur and put away in fridge for 2 hours.']

Name: Pineapple Right Side up Snack Cake
Ingredients: ['1 (8 ounce) can crushed pineapple, undrained', '2 12 cups flour', '1 tablespoon baking powder', '14 teaspoon salt', '34 cup sugar', '13 cup milk', '13 cup butter, melted', '2 eggs, beaten', '12 teaspoon vanilla extract', '12 cup brown sugar']

Name: Big Kahuna KD
Ingredients: ['1 pkg. (225 g) Kraft Dinner Macaroni and Cheese', '1/2 cup cubed ham', '1 cup pineapple chunks', '1/2 cup chopped green peppers', '1/2 cup chopped red peppers', '1/2 cup Cracker Barrel Shredded Part Skim Mozzarella Cheese']

Name: Baked Potatoes With a Spicy Filling
Ingredients: ['4 baking potatoes, each about 10 oz', '1 tablespoon vegetable oil (optional)', '1 (14 ounce) can garbanzo beans, drained', '1 teaspoon ground coriander', '1 teaspoon ground cumin', '4 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped', '23 cup low-fat unsweetened yogurt', 'salt and pepper']
Instructions: ['Preheat the oven to 400.', 'Scrub the potatoes and pat dry.', 'Prick all over with a fork, brush with oil if you are using it and season with salt and pepper.', 'Place the potatoes on a cookie sheet and bake for 1 1/2 hours or until cooked through.', 'Cool for 10 minutes.', 'Meanwhile, mash the garbanzo beans with a fork or potato masher.', 'Stir in the spices and half the chopped cilantro.', 'Cover and set aside.', 'Halve the cooked potatoes and scoop the flesh into bowl keeping the potato shells intact.', 'Mash the flesh until smooth and gently mix into the garbanzo bean mixture with the yogurt.', 'Season well with salt and pepper.', 'Fill the potato shells with the potato/garbanzo bean mixture and place on a cookie sheet.', 'Return the potatoes to the oven and bake for 10-15 minutes longer, until heated through.', 'Serve sprinkled with the remaining chopped cilantro.']

Name: Trish's Easy Chili

Name: Spinach Scoops
Ingredients: ['1 package frozen spinach, thawed and drained', '1 package cream cheese, soften', '1 (8 ounce) container chives, dip', '1 package imitation crabmeat', '12 ounces shredded mozzarella cheese', '1 bag of scoops corn chips']

Name: Berries With Honey Sour Cream Sauce
Ingredients: ['1 quart fresh strawberries, halved', '1 pint fresh raspberry', '1 pint fresh blueberries', '1 pint fresh blackberries', '1 (16 ounce) carton low-fat sour cream', '14 cup honey']

Name: Buffalo Chicken Mac & Cheese
Ingredients: ["2 packages 6oz. Packages, Annie's Homegrown Shells And Real Cheddar Macaroni And Cheese", '6 Tablespoons Milk', '5 Tablespoons Hot Sauce ( I Used Franks Hot Sauce), Add More To Taste', '6 ounces, weight Chicken, Cooked, Diced Into Small Pieces']
Instructions: ['Bring 12 cups of water to a boil and stir in pasta.', 'Bring water back to a boil and cook for 8-10 minutes or until done according to package instructions.', 'Make sure to stir occasionally.', 'Drain pasta.', 'Add the milk into a medium-sized saucepan over medium-low heat.', 'Sprinkle the cheese mix from each packet and the hot sauce over milk, stir until combined.', 'Add cooked pasta and chicken, stir until pasta and chicken are completely coated.', 'Serve.']

Name: Memories of Chicken Casserole

Name: Pantry Corn Salad

Name: Cream Cheese Chicken Ranch Spread
Ingredients: ['2 (8 ounce) packages cream cheese, softened', '1 (1 ounce) packethidden valley ranch dip mix', '1 cup sharp cheddar cheese (finely shredded)', '1 (12 1/2 ounce) can chicken, drained or 1 cup finely shredded cooked chicken']
Instructions: ['Mix softened cream cheese and ranch dip mix together.', 'Mix well.', 'Then add sharp cheddar cheese to the cream cheese ranch mixture.', 'Blend well.', 'Lastly add in chicken.', 'You may want to crumble it with your hand to make the pieces smaller.', '(or use a chopper to make it smaller) Mix all ingredients well.', 'Store in air tight container in the fridge.', 'Can be served immediately, but best if it sits over night.', 'Best served with Ritz crackers.', 'Will last about a week in the fridge.', 'Note: You can shape this into a ball and then roll in chopped pecans if desired, but we just leave it as a spread.', 'ENJOY!']

Name: Cheap Irish Colcannon
Ingredients: ['2 1/2 cups thinly sliced green cabbage', '1 cup chopped broccoli', '3 cups hot prepared instant mashed potatoes', '4 tablespoons butter, or as needed', '1 pinch garlic salt', 'ground black pepper to taste']

Name: Bhagari Jhinga (Coconut Curry Shrimp)
Ingredients: ['1 tablespoon tomato paste', '12 teaspoon salt', '1 teaspoon white sugar', '1 teaspoon garam masala', '12 teaspoon ground cumin', '18 teaspoon ground red pepper', '3 tablespoons fresh cilantro, minced', '1 fresh jalapeno pepper, chopped', '1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice', '1 cup coconut milk', '3 tablespoons vegetable oil', '1 teaspoon black mustard seeds', '3 garlic cloves, minced', '1 14 lbs medium shrimp, peeled and deveined', '1 tablespoon cornstarch', '1 tablespoon cold water', '5 cups cooked rice']
Instructions: ['In a medium bowl, stir together tomato paste, salt, sugar, garam masala, ground cumin seed, ground red pepper, cilantro, jalapeno pepper, lemon juice, and coconut milk.', 'Set coconut sauce aside.', 'Heat oil in a wok or frying pan over medium-high heat.', 'When oil is hot, add the mustard seeds, and cook until they begin to pop.', 'Immediately stir in garlic, and cook until garlic begins to brown.', 'Add shrimp, and cook until shrimp is opaque; this should take only a minute or two.', 'Pour the coconut sauce over the shrimp; cook until the sauce begins to simmer.', 'In a small bowl, mix together cornstarch and water; stir into the sauce, and continue cooking until thick.']

Name: Cheese Torte
Ingredients: ['2 tablespoons oil', '3 flour tortillas', '8 ounces refried beans', '12 small onion, chopped', '12 red pepper, chopped', '1 cup monterey jack pepper cheese, shredded', '1 cup colby-monterey jack cheese, shredded']
